title: Introduction to Web Design and Development: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
unitTitle: Introduction to Web Design and Development
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain the following.
URL
Scripting language
MIME
XHTML
Giving an example, showcase the difference between Java and JavaScript as used in web development.
Define a tag. Explain 3 types of attributes that can be used in HTML code.
By giving an example for each, distinguish external and embedded style sheets.
By using appropriate examples, distinguish the following constructs as used in JavaScript.
Else-if-then
For loop
Do while
Describe the process/steps involved during web project management.
Describe any five factors that should be considered by an organization when finding a web design firm.
Give any two examples of web browsers that you know of.
Distinguish between the following.
Web site and web page
Client-side scripting language and server-side scripting language
Post and get form methods

A form contains a text input type where the user is required to enter a number. Write a JavaScript that would validate the form to ensure that the text input is not null or a non-numeric value. Include comments in the script.
Describe the client-server architecture in relation to internet services and give its advantage.

Write HTML code that would render a table titled "Purchased Equipments (June, 2006)", with the columns Item Num#, Item Picture, Item Description and Price. Item 1 is an IBM clone computer ($400.00, picture comp.jpg) and item 2 is a 1GB RAM module for a computer ($50.00, picture printer.png); each item is followed by a row "Shipping Handling, Installation, etc" with its expense ($20.00 and $14.00 respectively). The title is repeated at the bottom of the table. The table width is 80% of the screen width.
Distinguish between a static website and a dynamic website.
Briefly outline the advantages of CSS.
Explain any three attributes of the <BODY> tag which can be used to alter the page background.

Write the HTML code that produces a page with a dark sidebar containing a house icon on the left, a centred heading "HTML!", a subheading "Welcome", the line "The tags are here somewhere." with the word "tags" in bold, and the footer "(c) Jan Smith 1999" at the bottom.
Give the syntax for the following.
A check box used to create a form.
Inserting a video clip.
Demonstrate using code how you create a link that takes you to a different section of the same page.
Write a JavaScript to print the following pattern, with each row alternating 1 and 0 and each row one digit longer than the last: 1, 01, 101, 0101, 10101, 010101.
With the use of a code illustration, differentiate an inline style sheet from an embedded style sheet.
